name: fxf_s5_mvfix
doc: Stands in for S5_mvfix.state (a scene-5 mover capture with the new game's story flags, storyline 0): the ROM's own loader (--teleport 5 8 8 0, method jmp) from Crono's bedroom puts the lead at the fair's tile (8,8) facing up -- the reference's $0102-$0104 -- with the bedroom's flags, as the reference has.
